notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Version 1.1.0 is now live. Here is the list of fixes for this new version:

- Fixed issue where AI would freeze if the player with the ball was on the defence line.
- Fixed issue where AI was able to use abilities when frozen or asleep.
- Fixed issue where the game would freeze if a player in front of a barrier pressed move and then pressed confirm again with a controller.
- Fixed striking dribble not applying ability cost.
- Minor fix in the equipment tutorial text.


Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Ganbare! Super Strikers is now available in consoles
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Ganbare! Super Strikers has finally been released on PS4 / PS Vita, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch. And version 1.0.8 is now live on Steam with the the few changes that those new versions bring:


- Added hard mode. Normal mode is now a bit easier and hard mode is added for those who  want an extra challenge
- Tweaks on AI


Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Version 1.0.7 is now live. Here is the list of changes introduced in this new version:


- Added an easy mode. If you are having issues winning a match you can change the difficulty mode in the options menu.
- Improved the experience system. Part of the XP earned by a player is now shared with the rest of the team, to avoid more active players having a level way higher than the rest of the team.
- Short passes are now ground passes.
- You can now quickly select your players by pressing L and R triggers.
- Fixed bug where PKs weren't playable with 2 controllers.
- Fixes on Japanese localisation.
- Minor tweaks and bug fixes.


This is probably the last update I will upload for the game, other than to fix issues. It's been almost a year since I released the game on Steam and with the console versions shaping up nicely is time to start thinking about what's next.

Thank you everyone for playing the game and for your support!


Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Version 1.0.6 is now live. This update is mostly bug fixes and small tweaks to make the game easier to use. The most important changes are:

- Redesign of the Change Formation Menu screen to increase readability and make it easier to use with controllers.
- Addition of a "Speed Up" button to increase the speed of the AI's turn.
- Added a new type of gamepad with icons for the Xbox One controller.
- Tweaks on AI behaviour.
- Tweaks and fixes on controller behaviour in general.

If you enjoy the game and are happy with my work please consider leaving a review on Steam. It really helps small indie developers like myself!

Special thanks to the user Crusher who compiled an extensive list of bugs and posted it on the forums:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/419990/discussions/0/1778262124921789573/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/419990/discussions/0/1778262124921789573/[/url]

Thanks,
Ruben

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Version 1.0.5 is now live. This update brings two more languages, Italian and French, to the game. There are also a few improvements and bug fixes. The complete list of changes is here:

- French and Italian localisation.
- Fixed a bug in Tournaments and Leagues that would prevent the competition from progressing.
- Up to 8 players can now participate in Tournaments and Leagues.
- Tweaks and improvements to the camera.
- You can now end your turn pressing the Enter key.
- You can now use your mouse wheel to zoom the camera in and out
- Minor bug fixes and tweaks

Thanks,
Ruben

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

The first proper update for Ganbare! Super Strikers is here! I have been taking into consideration the feedback from everyone and I have made some changes to the game, as well as fixed some minor issues. You can find the complete list of changes / fixes here:

- Players can now earn EXP even when losing a match
- Level caps for Story Mode matches have been removed
- AI won't freeze now due to offside
- Some game-breaking situations have been fixed
- When moving a player, his path is now automatically updated to the most efficient one (unless dribbling any opponents in the way)
- Fixes around away team kits
- Action tutorials (Move, Pass, Tackle...) can now be skipped
- Small fixes around tutorials
- Fixed issue where players wouldn't get tired after running out of SP after a move
- Improvements to Helix Shot
- Fixed issue where deleting a save game and creating a new save game on that same slot would crash the game

Cheers,
Ruben
